Commentary.Commentary: The England players are already out in the middle for their warm up, around 10 minutes before the play is about to start. They had been practicing their yorkers even in the morning session and now they are at it again. Maybe to sort out their death bowling woes?

280 to win. The pitch looks to be spinning and a tad bit on the slower side. England's bowlers are more efficient than their counterparts. The Plate should be going to England. Join us back at 2 pm local (1200 GMT) for the run chase.

Jack Haynes is down for an interview. He says that they have been looking to build huge partnerships throughout the tournament and today it came off. Says that the surface was a good one but in the end, there was a little more grip. Says that their two spinners, Lewis Goldsworthy and Hamidullah Qadri will have a massive part to play in the second innings. Adds that it was a brilliant innings by Dan Mousley. Says his performance is great for the team and it gives them confidence. Identifies that the middle overs will be the key for both sides.

Sri Lanka started with a bang, with Madushanka nipping out Young early. But after that, it was a struggle, as they simply could not pick wickets at regular intervals. Sudeera Thilakaratne tried to keep the English quiet in the middle overs but the wickets did not come as quickly as he would have liked. And then, we witnessed a bizarre piece of captaincy from Nipun Dananjaya, not bowling out Madushanka and giving the part-timer Paranavithana an over in the 45th. That shifted the momentum totally, as he went for 15. And to rub salt on the wounds, Madushanka bowled brilliantly at the death - as if to ask - 'Hey skip, did you forget that I had three overs left?'

When England lost three wickets between overs 38-44, for just 21 runs, there seemed to be a massive shift in momentum - but in came Joey Evison and played a wonderful cameo of 59 from 45 balls, lifting England towards 280. Well, almost.

An innings which was driven by the fact that if an opener or a top order batsman bats through or for a major portion of the innings, the team inadvertently gets a big total. Dan Mousley took over that responsibility here, batting till the 44th over and ensuring that England have a good platform set for a carnage towards the end. He got good support from Cox and Haynes, although Cox did not score that many. However, he crucially hung in there, especially after the early loss of Young in the first over.

A decent total posted by England. Although, they would have mixed feelings about the same. When Mousley and Haynes were going strong, 300 looked gettable. But when they lost 2 wickets in the span of 4 balls towards the end of Powerplay 2, questions would have popped up in their minds.

OUT! Timber! Sri Lanka finish the innings with a wicket. A full ball on middle, Evison moves to the off side and looks to flick it over short fine leg but misses. The ball though does not miss its target and demolishes the stumps. 6 runs and a wicket off the final over.
Another couple! Brilliant running between the wickets. Full ball on middle, flicked to long on and a couple of runs taken.
Full ball on middle, Evison looks to flick but the ball goes to deep square leg off the inner half of the bat. A couple more.
Good bouncer! Evison is caught in two minds, whether to go for the pull or guide it over cover. He does nothing and its a dot ball.
Length ball outside off, Evison moves across the off side and looks to scoop but misses to get any bat on it. With fine leg up, it is a good option but one needs to connect.
Follows the bowler and bowls a full toss on the pads, Evison pushes it towards long on and scampers back for the second. Good stuff from Aldridge.
Low full toss on middle, it is stroked to long on for a single. That's it from Dilshan in this innings with the ball. 41/2 in his 9-over spell.
FOUR! Misses the yorker and gets punished! Full toss outside off, Evison strokes it over cover for a boundary to get to his half ton.
Another yorker! Aldridge looks to keep it out but fails to get hit on the pads. The ball goes towards the off side for a leg bye.
Kasey Aldridge is the new man in.

OUT! Bowled 'em! Excellent bowling from Dilshan and he deserves this scalp. Bowls a length ball around off, Balderson looks to smash him through the off side but gets a thick inside edge. The ball then shatters the timber behind.
Another dot, courtesy another brilliant yorker. Balderson looks to dig it out but fails to do so. Mishara behind the wicket does well to pouch the ball to his right.
Excellent start to the penultimate over from Dilshan. Bowls it full and outside off, Balderson looks to reach out but fails to put any bat on ball.
Well directed bouncer to end the over! It is just around off, Evison lets it be. 13 from the 48th over.
Swing and a miss! A length ball outside off, Evison looks to hammer it over off side but makes no connection.
Excellent running between the wickets. Length ball on off, Evison looks to flick but the ball takes the inner half of the bat and goes to deep square leg. A couple taken.
SIX! Brilliant pick up shot. A length ball on the pads, Evison tonks it over the man at deep mid-wicket for a maximum.
FOUR! Lucky runs! A good length ball on off and middle, Evison moves back to make room. He then looks to drive but the ball takes the inside edge and goes to the fine leg fence.
Low full toss on middle, it is stroked towards long on for a single. It went towards the fielder uppishly but bounced well in front of him.
Chamindu Wijesinghe is back on to bowl now. 7-0-40-0, his figures so far.
Brilliant finish to the over! This is quality bowling from Dilshan. Wide yorker outside off, Evison looks to squeeze it out but misses. 4 from the over.

It is another excellent fuller ball around off, Balderson strokes it well but it goes straight to the man at mid off on the bounce. They take off for a single. The fielder there throws the ball quickly at the non-striker's end but misses. Balderson puts in a dive. A direct hit would've consumed him there.
Full ball on off, creamed through covers but straight to the man in the deep. Just a single.
Another good yorker! It is just outside off, Evison looks to get bat on ball but fails.
Very full ball on off, almost a yorker, Balderson does well to jam it out towards mid on for a single.
Full and around off from Dilshan, Evison strokes it to long off and takes a single.
Dilshan Madushanka is back on. 7-0-32-1, his figures so far. Bizarre captaincy from Dananjaya. This means that Madushanka will not bowl his 10 overs. Easily their best bowler.
Full and on middle, pushed back to the bowler. Another good over for England, 9 from it.
Short and on middle, pulled towards the deep mid-wicket region where Dilshan does well to field in the end. A couple taken. 250 up for England.
Full and outside off, drilled to long on for a single.
Around off, pushed for a single to long on.

FOUR! Misjudgement from Dilshan Madushanka and that has cost the Lankans. Floated delivery on the pads, Balderson goes down on one knee and plays the sweep shot. Dilshan runs to his right from backward square leg but the ball spins away to his left after bouncing and he has overrun there. The ball goes into the fence and the bowler is digusted with this.
Floated on off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Kavindu Nadeeshan to bowl out. 9-0-49-1 from him so far.
Floated outside off, drilled through extra cover for a single. 15 from the over. A top one for the Englishmen.
On middle, pushed to long on for a run.
Full and on the pads, flicked for a run to deep mid-wicket.
SIX! Back-to-back sixes! A loopy and fuller ball outside off, Evison nails the slog over long on for a huge six.

SIX! The skipper has made a bad decision there. Floated delivery outside off, Evison goes down on one knee and goes for the slog sweep. It is flat in trajectory. Nipun Dananjaya is standing about 10 yards inside the boundary line and that is why the ball goes over him for a six. Had he stayed on the ropes, that would have been an easy catch.
Short and wide outside off, Evison looks to cut but misses.
This is interesting. A new bowler, in the 45th over. Navod Paranavithana comes into the attack.
Short ball on middle, it is pulled for a single to deep square leg. End of a successful over for Sri Lanka.
Full and on middle, swept for a single to deep square leg.
Slightly short and around off, Evison slaps it through covers for a single.
On the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
George Balderson is the new man in. Can the skipper play a cameo and take the score close to 300? There seems to be a momentum shift here...

OUT! Stumped! Nelson strikes for Mousley. A googly on off and middle, Dan skips down the track and looks to go downtown. He though fails to make any connection. Mishara behind the wicket collects the ball and whips the bails off. The centurion departs now.
Short and outside off, Evison strokes it to mid off for a single.
Kavindu Nadeeshan returns. 8-0-44-0 from him so far.
Full and on middle, it is stroked to long on for a run.
Shortish and around off, it is blocked.

FOUR! Edgy! Full and wide outside off, had Evison let it go, it would have been signalled as a wide but Evison goes after it. He but ends up bottom edging it. The ball goes to the third man fence as short third man gives it a chase.
Full and on middle and leg, forced to long on for a single.
Shorter and around off, this time Evison forces it towards cover-point for a run.
On off, pushed towards mid off.
It looks like the time has approached for England to up the ante here! With 8 overs left to play, they should be aiming at least a total of 280 from here if not more.
Loopy ball around off and middle, it is worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker and shorter, worked towards mid on.
Quicker one on the pads, Evison looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads.
Shortish and on middle, Mousley comes down the track and strokes it to long on for a single.
On middle, driven to long on for an easy run.
Full ball on off, pushed towards point.
On the pads, Mousley misses his flick and the ball hits his pads.
This time Evison rocks back and punches this ball back towards long on for a single.
Floated on middle and off, pushed down towards long on for a single.
On the pads again, flicked towards the man at mid on.
Mousley rocks back and defends the ball.
Floated on middle, flicked towards the man at mid-wicket who fakes a shy at the non-striker's end.
Powerplay 3 is underway. A maximum of 5 fielders are now allowed outside the circle until the end of the innings.

FOUR! Edgy runs! Quicker one on middle and leg, Evison looks to guide it towards fine leg but the ball takes a thick inside edge and goes to the left of the man at short fine leg. The fielder there dives but fails to stop and the ball races away to the fence.
Full and on the pads, worked towards the leg side.
Shortish and around off, tapped towards the leg side for a single.
Loopy ball on middle, pushed to the left of the bowler who tries to stop the ball but collides with the non-striker. The ball deflects towards mid on.
Another one on the pads, Evison works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Quicker one on the pads, defended towards mid-wicket.
Shortish around off, tapped through cover for a single to get off the mark. 2 runs and wicket from the over.
Another ball which is slower through the air and it is on middle, Evison keeps it out.
Slower through the air on the pads, worked towards mid-wicket.
Joey Evison replaces George Hill out in the middle with opener Dan Mousley still at the crease.

OUT! Caught! Two in quick time for Sri Lanka. George Hill fails to make any mark in this game. A flighted ball on middle, Hill looks to flick but ends up chipping it towards Nipun Dhananjaya at short mid-wicket. The Lankan skipper dives forward and pouches the ball nicely. Sri Lanka with an opportunity to make a comeback and restrict England around 275.
Another shortish one, blocked off the back foot.
Flatter and outside off, cut to deep point for a run.

George Hill is the new man in. Can he play a cameo and provide a flourish along with Mousley to the English innings? A bowling change as Sudeera Thilakaratne comes back on. 6-0-28-1, his figures so far.

OUT! Caught! Daniel has his first and the huge stand is finally broken. A flighted ball just around off, Haynes comes down the track and look to clear the man at mid off. However, he does not get the elevation he wanted. It goes straight to Thilakaratne at mid off who makes no mistake. A fine innings from Haynes comes to an end.
Full ball on the pads, flicked to mid-wicket.
Floated on middle and off, Mousley comes down the track and pushes this one down the ground for a single.
Floated delivery just outside off, Haynes has swept this away towards deep square leg for a single and this brings up the 200 for England.
Action replay of the previous delivery.
Short and around off, worked straight to short mid-wicket.
Ashian Daniel is back on. 7-0-34-0, his figures so far.
Full and around middle, worked through mid-wicket for a brace.
Comes down the track and whips it to long on for one.
Short and outside off, cut through the covers for a run.
Full and around off, Haynes comes down the track and pushes it towards long on for a single.

WIDE AND A RUN OUT MISSED. Full and down the leg side, Mousley looks to sweep but misses. The ball goes off the keeper's pads to short third man. Haynes calls Mousley through for a single but it is a late call. The fielder from short third man gets to the ball, takes aim and has a shy at the bowler's end. Misses. Mousley was a goner had that hit. One question - why wasn't the bowler at the stumps?
Around off, blocked.
Short and on middle, pulled for a single to deep mid-wicket.
On the pads of Haynes, worked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Full ball on middle, swept for a run towards deep square leg.

FOUR! 100 up for Mousley! His 1st in U19 cricket. He pumps the air with his fists and hugs his partner at the other end. It is a brilliant shot to get to the land mark. A fuller ball on the pads, he whips it towards deep mid-wicket. The man from deep square leg runs to his right and dives to stop the ball but fails to do so. A top knock from the opener and now he will look to provide a flourish in the final phase.

The physio has come out now and is having a look at Ahan's wrist. It looks like a very bad injury. Ahan Wickramasinghe has been taken off the field and Mohammad Shamaaz has come on as the substitute fielder.

Flighted ball outside off, Haynes drills it towards covers where Ahan Wickramasinghe dives to his left to stop the ball. He makes a half stop and a run is taken. He shows some pain now. The replays roll in and show that he was hit really hard on his left wrist.
Full and down the leg side, Mousley sweeps it to backward square leg and gets a single.
Flatter and on middle, blocked back to the bowler.
Full ball on the pads, Haynes whips it towards wide long on. There is no one there. The deep mid-wicket fielder does well to get to the ball and relay it to the man from mid on. A couple taken.
Shorter and around off, pulled for a run to deep mid-wicket.
Around off, defended.
Floated on off, Haynes comes forward and makes it a full toss and works it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short and outside off, Mousley cuts it to deep point for a single.
Full and outside off, Haynes eases a single through covers.
Kavindu Nadeeshan comes back on. 6-0-30-0, his figures so far.
Full and on middle, pushed to long on for a run. 7 from the first over of the skipper.
On the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Swept away and enters into the 90s. Full and down the leg side, Mousley sits down and sweeps it past the short fine leg fielder. The fielder chases the ball down but fails to reach to the ball.
On the pads, flicked towards short fine leg.
Quicker one around off, Mousley taps it towards point. There is a half appeal from the bowler as he thinks it hit the pad first but nothing from the umpire.
Full toss to start with. Haynes pushes it to long on and changes ends.
Skipper Nipun Dananjaya to bowl now.

DRINKS BREAK. 17 overs left. 300 looks to be on from here, but with the hitters to come, can the Brits get to 350? 10 an over with so many overs to go seems farfetched but do not rule out the possibility. As far as Sri Lanka are concerned, they need to find ways to get wickets. Restrict the run-flow. That might result in some attempt to go big and fetch wickets. Too many easy singles on offer.
Full and around off, Haynes strokes it to long off for a run. 4 from the over, a tight one from Thilakaratne.
Full and on middle, it is swept for a run.
On middle, pushed to long on for an easy run.
On middle, Haynes comes down the track and looks to loft it over mid on but misses to get hit on the pads. It rolls towards covers and a leg bye is taken.
Slower through the air on middle, worked to square leg.
Loopy ball on middle, Mousley comes down the track and strokes it to mid on for a run.

EDGED AND FOUR! Lucky break for Haynes now! Full ball outside off, Haynes looks to go for an expansive drive. The ball goes off the outside edge, through the vacant slip cordon, into the third man fence in a flash.
Outside off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Full ball on middle, Haynes pushes it down to long on for a single.
This time it is on off, pushed towards cover for a single.

50 for Jack Haynes! He has played really well here. Back of a length ball wide outside off, Haynes rocks back and slashes at it. However the man at deep point gets across and slides to make a good stop. The batters take one and this brings up the 100-run stand too between Mousley and Haynes.
On the hips of Haynes, he flicks this one just behind square leg and takes a couple. Moves to 49 runs.
Chamindu Wijesinghe comes back into the attack. 6-0-30-0 are his numbers so far.

Mousley comes down the track again looking to go big but Thilakaratne bowls this one quicker and Mousley plays it back towards the bowler. Dan scampers back inside the crease as Thilakaratne aims to have a shy at the stumps.
On off, driven towards the man at long off and Haynes changes ends.
Tossed up delivery just outside off, pushed down towards long on and the batters take one.
Mousley comes down the track and plays this one towards the man at mid on.
Floated on the pads, worked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter one on middle and leg, flicked towards the man at short fine leg.
Bowling change! Sudeera Thilakaratne returns. 4-0-22-1 from him so far.
FOUR! Flicked nicely. 150 up for England. A fuller ball on the pads. Mousley gets to the pitch nicely and whips it to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Yorker on middle, Mousley looks to jam it out but ends up bottom edging it.

Run out chance missed! It is the skipper who misses out! Full and around off, Mousley drives it towards covers. The non-striker is out of his crease as Nipun picks the ball sharply and releases the throw at the non-striker's end but misses.
Another length ball around off, Mousley guides it towards point.
Full ball on the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball around off, defended.
This time he does not pick it. It is outside off on a flatter trajectory. Haynes looks to defend but misses. The ball goes towards short third man off his pads and a leg bye is taken.
FOUR! Done nicely in the end. It's a googly from Nadeeshan, it stays slightly low too. Mousley does well to flick and find the gap in the deep on the leg side with perfection.
Full and on the pads, easy single to deep square leg through a sweep.
Slightly short and just outside off, Mousley goes back and looks to cut but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Full and outside off, Haynes sweeps it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Flatter one on the pads, pushed past the diving bowler for a run to long on.
Length ball just outside off, Mousley punches it through covers for a single.
Shortish ball around off, this time Haynes runs it down to third man and takes a run.
Full ball outside off, Haynes drives it firmly through covers. The sweeper cover runs to his left and makes a tumbling stop but he cannot stop two runs.
Fuller and around off, pushed towards point.
Shortish ball on the body, blocked.
Length ball on the pads, it is worked towards mid-wicket for a single.
Dilshan Madushanka is back on! 5-0-22-1 from him so far.
Floated on off, swept towards deep square leg for a single.
Floated delivery on middle and off, another googly from Kavindu, Mousley looks to defend this one off the back foot but the ball goes off the outside edge towards third man.
Mousley this time rocks back and blocks this one out.
Similar delivery, again Mousley looks to go for the cut but is beaten.
Wide outside off, tossed up, it is the googly. Mousley looks to go after it but misses.
Mousley comes down the track and Kavindu bowls a quicker one. Mousley does well to keep it out.
Haynes comes down the track and pushes this back towards the bowler.
FOUR! Superb shot! Flatter one on off, Haynes rocks back and cuts this one behind backward point for a boundary.
Flatter one middle and leg, pushed down towards long on for one.
Full toss down the leg side, Mousley gets down and looks to beat the man at short fine leg but can't.
That one almost carried to the mid off fielder. Floated delivery around off, Mousley comes down the track and looks to smash it over mid off. He mistimes it and the ball falls just short.
On the pads, worked towards the leg side.
Flatter one on middle, pushed towards mid-wicket.
EDGED AND FOUR! A loopy delivery just outside off, it turns in and stays low. Haynes looks to defend but the ball goes off the inside edge towards fine leg for a boundary.
This time Haynes looks to come down the track, he looks to flick towards the leg side but the ball goes off the pads towards point.
Tossed up delivery full and on off, driven towards sweeper cover for a couple.
This time a loopy delivery on middle, Haynes prods forward and defends.
Floated delivery around off, defended out.
Around off, pushed towards long on for a run.
On the pads, worked towards the leg side for a single.
FOUR! This time Mousley connects the sweep as Daniel bowls another ball on the pads. He sits down and sweeps it to the fine leg fence.

OUT? Not out? Sri Lanka cannot believe it. Mousley would've had his heart in his mouth. Where did the ball hit? The Sri Lankans were pretty confident as they started to celebrate. A fuller ball down the leg side, Mousley looks to sweep but does not time it well. It hits something and lobs behind the keeper. The first slip fielder catches the ball easily and they start to celebrate. The umpire however says that it did not come off the glove or the bat. The replays roll in and show that it had hit the gloves. Mousley is very lucky here.
Short and outside off, Haynes goes back and slaps it through covers for a run.
Flatter and outside off, turned towards mid-wicket.
Ashian Daniel is back on. 5-0-22-0, his figures so far. His side needs him to take a wicket here.
Short and outside off, cut to deep point for a single.
On the pads, Haynes defends it out.
Uppish but safe! A flighted ball outside off, Mousley looks to drive but the ball hits the toe end of the bat and flies over point. A single taken.
Appeal for LBW but not out says the umpire. Flatter one on the pads, Mousley looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The bowler appeals but nothing from the umpire.
Full and around off, Haynes pushes it to long off and thinks for the second. Decides against it in the end.
On the pads, Mousley sweeps it to fine leg and takes a run.
Length ball on middle, Haynes has defended the ball off the back foot.

FOUR LEG BYES! Length ball down the leg side, Haynes looks to flick it fine down the leg side but misses. The ball kisses the thigh pad and races down to fine leg for four leg byes. This brings up the 50-run stand between Haynes and Mousley. England in a strong position here.
Bouncer on middle and off, Haynes ducks under it.
Length ball on off, pushed towards cover for a single.
Full ball around middle and leg, Haynes flicks this one towards mid-wicket. The man there dives and has a shy at the striker's end but misses.
Length ball around off, pushed towards the cover region for a single.
Full and around off, worked towards deep mid-wicket for a single. 8 from the over.
Flatter one on the pads, worked towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Full and on off, Mousley sweeps it well but it goes straight to deep mid-wicket on a couple of bounces. A single.
On the pads, worked towards deep mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Timed brilliantly! A boundary after 36 balls for England. Nadeeshan bowls a full ball outside off, Haynes gets to the pitch and creams it through covers. The sweeper cover runs across to his right and tries to make a diving stop but he fails.
Flatter ball around off, defended.
On middle, Mousley finds mid-wicket.
Length ball on off, Mousley looks to drive but the ball takes the inside edge and hits the pad.
Short and outside off, Haynes slashes it to deep point for a run.
Landed on middle on a length, Mousley pushes it towards mid on and calls for a quick single. He makes in with a dive as the throw from the fielder comes. He though misses but would not have mattered.
Short and just outside off, cut to point.

Full ball around off and middle, it is pushed back to the bowler. Wijesinghe picks the ball in his followthrough and fires the throw at the striker's end. He hits but the batter never left the crease. Few words exchanged there.
On the pads of Mousley, he goes back and punches this one towards long on and takes a single.
Floated delivery on middle and leg, Mousley goes back and defends.
Nicely played this one by Haynes. On middle, loopy delivery. It pitches and stays low. Haynes does well to get bat on ball and works this one towards mid-wicket for a single.
Bad delivery this one, on middle and way short. Mousley rocks back and pulls towards mid-wicket but just a single.
This time a loopy delivery outside off, defended out.
Kavindu starts with a tossed up delivery around off, Haynes shuffles and works it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Kavindu Nadeeshan to bowl now.
Good length ball just outside off, Mousley plays this one towards the man at point.
On the pads, flicked towards square leg and Haynes changes ends.
Outside off, guided down towards third man for a single.

Beaten! Lucky not to edge that one! First time this morning that Mousley has been lazy, neither going on the front foot nor on the back. Goes for a lazy poke but misses and the ball whizzes past his outside edge.
Good length ball on middle and leg, flicked towards mid-wicket and the batters take a couple.
Length ball outside off, played towards point for a single.
Flatter one on middle and off, pushed back towards the bowler. 4 runs off the over.
Haynes pushes this one through the covers for a single.
On middle and off, tossed up, pushed towards long on for a single.
Another one on the hips, Mousley looks to glance but misses to get hit on the thigh pads.
Flatter one now, on the hips, Mousley goes back and works this one towards mid-wicket.
Tossed up delivery down the leg side, Mousley gets down on one knee and plays the sweep shot. He beats the man at short fine leg but the man in the deep clears it up and the batters take two.

DRINKS BREAK. England will be happy with this score. The pitch looks a good one to bat on but also is showing signs of turn. 250 could be a good score on this deck. Mousley is looking in good touch and will aim to bat for at least another 10 overs or so. The Lankans need to pick up wickets and try and restrict the English under 200.
Flatter one on middle and leg, Mousley pushes it down the ground towards long on for a single. He retains strike for the next over.
Tossed up on off, pushed towards the cover region again.
Tossed up on off, pushed towards the man at cover.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman. They pick up a single.
Another one on middle, this time Mousley rocks back and pushes this one towards long on for a single.
Flatter one on middle and off, pushed towards cover off the back foot for a single.
Chamindu Wijesinghe is back on. 2-0-16-0 so far.
Floated on off, pushed towards long off for a single.
Floated on middle and off, Haynes pushes this one straight back towards the bowler.
Flatter one on middle and off, this time Mousley flicks it towards square leg for a single.
On the pads, worked towards the leg side for one.
Flatter one on middle and off, pushed towards long on for a single.

FOUR! Up and over! Floated delivery on middle and off, Mousley comes down the track and lofts this one over the man at mid off for a boundary. That will bring up the tournament's third half ton for Mousley.
Floated on off, pushed straight to the man at mid off.
Flatter one around off, turning back in, Haynes looks to shuffle and flick but misses to get hit on the thigh pad outside off.
Flatter one on middle and off, played towards point off the back foot for a single.
Tossed up delivery, again Haynes comes down the track and this time pushes it towards long on for a single.
Haynes comes down the track and pushes this one back towards the bowler.
Floated delivery around off, pushed towards the man at mid on for a single.
Quicker one on middle, Mousley flicks it to long on for a single.
On middle, Mousley comes down the track and pushes it towards bowler.
Full and just outside off, pushed towards covers.
Flatter one around off, blocked back to the bowler.
The batsman gets a leading edge on that one. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On off, Haynes taps it towards off side and thinks off for a run but Mousley sends him back.
Flatter one around off, blocked off the back foot.

Very full ball on middle, it is flicked wide of the man at long on. The batters take the first run quickly and put pressure on the charging fielder. He fumbles and they easily get the second in the end.
This is quicker and outside off, Haynes taps it through point for a single.
Another ball similar to the second one, Haynes once again defends it back to the bowler.
Slightly short one, turning in, Haynes pushes it back to the bowler.
Full and on middle, Mousley pushes it to long on for a single.
Full and around off, Haynes skips down the track and works it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Haynes is off the mark with this.
Jack Haynes is the new man in. He comes in after a solid 2nd-wicket stand between Cox and Mousley and now will be looking to build from here.

OUT! LBW! Thilakaratne strikes in his very first over and sends Cox back to the pavilion. He is not happy but he will have to go. A loopy ball on middle, Cox looks to flick but misses. The ball hits the back pad. The bowler and the keeper appeal and the umpire raises his finger. The 58-run stand is broken.
Slightly short and outside off, Cox goes on the back foot and cuts it to deep point. Before the sweeper cover runs across to his left, Cox gets a couple.
On the pads, this time Mousley flicks it to deep mid-wicket for an easy single.
Loopy ball outside off, Mousley comes forward and drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Full and around off and middle, Cox pushes it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Powerplay 2 gets underway now! A maximum of 4 fielders are now allowed outside the circle until the 40th over. Also, Sudeera Thilakaratne comes on to bowl.
Flights this one outside off, Dan looks to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes to short third man. 53/1 at the end of the first Powerplay.
Flatter and around off, blocked back to the bowler.
Loopy ball around off, Mousley comes forward and keeps it out.
On middle, pushed towards mid on.
A couple now! Full and on the pads, Mousley strokes it wide of the man at long on and scampers back for a couple of runs. 50-run stand  is up between the two.

FOUR! Poor ball to start from Daniel. It is on the pads of Mousley. He gently helps it towards fine leg. There is a man at short fine leg but he fails to cut it off. He tries to chase the ball but comes second.
Ashian Daniel is back on. 2-0-9-0 from him so far.
On the pads, this time Mousley tucks it around the corner and keeps the strike with him for the next over.
FOUR! Pierced the gap to perfection. Too full from Dilshan, Mousley leans into the shot and caresses it through point for a boundary. He opened the bat face nicely there.
Fuller and around off, pushed to mid off.
FOUR! Whipped nicely! Madushanka angles the ball into the left-hander, Mousley flicks it nicely. The ball races away to the wide long on fence.
Length ball on off, defended towards mid off.
Full ball just outside off, Mousley strokes it well but straight to the man at covers.
Short and outside off, Cox cuts but can't beat the point fielder.
On the pads, Mousley nudges it behind square leg for a single.
FOUR! Hammered through the covers. England are now starting to take the advantage of the first Powerplay. Overpitched and outside off, Mousley leans into the shot and drills it through covers.
Good length ball around off, it is defended.
Length ball on the body, blocked.

SIX! That almost flied over the ropes. That looked like a mistimed shot but not really. A back of a length ball on middle, Mousley looks to pull but gets a leading edge. For a moment, the square leg fielder would've thought he had a chance there but the ball kept going away and eventually landed full on the ropes which is confirmed by the third umpire.
FOUR! Pulled away! Second boundary by Cox. A back of a length ball on middle, Cox swivels and hammers it with a pull. The ball races away to the deep mid-wicket fence.
Full and around off, blocked off the back foot.
Length ball outside off, angled away. Cox watchfully lets it be.
Flicked for a single! A fuller ball on middle, Mousley advances a couple of steps and flicks it to fine leg for a single.
Length ball around off, pushed towards covers.
Full and outside off, Mousley drives it straight to the point fielder.
Around off, defended off the back foot.

FOUR! First one of the game. This is timed brilliantly. A length ball angled into the batter. Cox waits for it and then flicks it to the deep mid-wicket fence. The fielder from mid-wicket gives it a chase but he comes second.
Length ball around off, pushed towards point.

Huge appeal for a caught behind but not out says the umpire. Wijesinghe strays on the pads of Cox who looks to flick but misses. There is a noise as the ball goes behind. The Lankans appeal but nothing from the umpire. The replays roll in and show that the ball had brushed the pads on its way to the keeper.
Shortish ball on off, Mousley goes on the back foot and dabs it down to third man for a single.
Good length ball around off to start the spell from Chamindu. Mousley defends it towards point.
Chamindu Wijesinghe is on now.
Length ball around off, Mousley taps it through point for a run.

Excellent shot, equally well fielded too. A fuller length ball on the pads, Cox flicks it nicely towards fine leg. The ball seems to be going to the fence but the fielder there runs across to his left and makes a tumbling save and releases the ball quickly too. Three runs saved.
Another length ball in the channel outside off, Cox leaves it alone again.
Fuller and outside off, inviting the batter for drive, Cox resists himself and lets it be.
Full and on the pads, Mousley flicks it towards fine leg for a run.
Length ball around off, pushed towards point by Mousley.
On the pads again, Cox tucks it towards deep square leg and before the fielder in the deep can come across to field, a couple of runs taken.
On the pads of Mousley, he works it behind square leg for a single.
Fuller and around middle, Cox pushes it towards mid on for a run.
Quicker one on the pads, blocked.

In the air... but goes on the bounce to the man at mid-wicket. A loopy ball on middle and leg, Mousley comes down the track and looks to clear deep-mid-wicket but he does not time it well. The bat turns in his hand and the ball goes to deep mid-wicket on the bounce.
Around off, Cox eases a single through mid on.
Top ball to finish the over. It is yorker on middle, Mousley blocks it well. 3 from the over.
WIDE! Strays down the leg side. Mousley looks to pull but does not connect. Wided by the umpire.
Good length ball around off, it is angled into the batter. Mousley blocks it off his back foot.
Short one on the body, Mousley swivels and pulls it to deep square leg for a couple of runs.
Another excellent delivery! Very full ball around off and middle, Mousley does well to keep it out off the toe end of the willow.
Full ball on middle, it is pushed back to the bowler.
Slightly shortish ball around off, Mousley goes on the back foot and taps it towards point.
Floated around off, Cox defends it back to the bowler. Good start from Daniel too.
Quick run! A full ball on the pads, Mousley tucks it wide of mid on and takes off for a run.
Flatter and quicker, this time Cox pushes it to long on and opens his account.
Flatter and on middle, Cox pushes it back to the bowler.
Floats this one around off, it is defended off the front foot.
He starts with a ball on the pads, it is flicked towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Spin from the other end as Ashian Daniel comes to bowl. 1 slip in place.

Beauty to end the over! It is a length ball on middle, it comes into the batter as Cox thinks of leaving it alone. However, the ball hits his arms and goes past the stumps. Brilliant over first up for Sri Lanka from Madushanka.
On the pads, worked towards square leg.
WIDE! First extra of the game. It is wide outside off, Cox lets it be. The umpire wides it as it goes way outside off.
Jordan Cox walks in at number 3, replacing Young.

OUT! Caught behind! Sri Lanka draw first blood early on. This is a very poor shot from Young. It is wide and outside off. Just the first over of the innings and Young throws his bat at it. The ball takes the outside edge and goes behind. Mishara behind the wicket does not make any mistake. He pouches and the Lankans appeal. The umpire agrees and Young departs for a 2-ball duck. Top start for Sri Lanka.
Another back of a length ball on middle, this time it is to the right-hander. Young looks to defend but the ball bounces a bit extra and hits the handle of the bat and rolls towards mid-wicket.
England are underway! Short and wide outside off, Mousley taps it past the man at point for a single.
A bouncer to begin with. That went very slowly to the keeper. It is banged in middle, Mousley ducks under it and allows it to go to the keeper.

Done and dusted with the National Anthems. It is time for the action to begin. The Sri Lankan players get to their positions after the skipper has a final word with them in the huddle. The two English openers, Sam Young and Dan Mousley make their way out in the middle. Dilshan Madushanka to start the proceedings for the Lankans first up. Here we go...
Time for the National Anthem of both the sides before the action begins. First up is of England and it will be followed by the Sri Lankan anthem.

England skipper, George Balderson says, they have practiced hard and want to play hard in this game. Tells that they will look to rectify their errors in the past matches. Confirms one change in the side which is Kasey Aldridge coming in. Doesn't inform for whom though... We figured out that it is Blake Cullen.

Sri Lanka skipper, Nipun Dananjaya says that, there is some moisture on the wicket and they want to use that to their advantage. Tells that after the twin losses, the side came well and now they are looking to do better in this Plate final. Adds that they always tell the players to play for the win. Reveals they are playing the same XI as the last game.

HD Ackermann is in with the pitch report. Tells that boundaries are fairly big on this ground. Adds that if the batters need to clear them, they need to hit the ball really hard. Andy Flower joins for the chat and tells that it is a pitch which offers something or the other for both departments. Ends by saying that there will be a little bit of turn on offer and feels batting will be a bit easier.

England U19 (Playing XI) - Dan Mousley, Sam Young, Jordan Cox (WK), Jack Haynes, George Hill, Joey Evison, Lewis Goldsworthy, George Balderson (C), Kasey Aldridge (In for Blake Cullen), Scott Currie, Hamidullah Qadri

Sri Lanka Under 19 (Unchanged Playing XI) - Navod Paranavithana, Kamil Mishara (WK), Ravindu Rasantha, Nipun Dananjaya (C), Ahan Wickramasinghe, Chamindu Wijesinghe, Sonal Dinusha, Kavindu Nadeeshan, Sudeera Thilakaratne, Ashian Daniel, Dilshan Madushanka.
TOSS - Up goes the coin and it lands in Sri Lanka's favour. THEY WILL BOWL FIRST.

It is time for the Plate finals before the knockout round of the U19 World Cup. Two quality sides who could not make it to the final 8 of the main draw lock horns to prove their mettle and end their tournament on a positive note. Let's hope we get an exciting game. Stay with us for Toss and team updates.
